RIGNITC | Robotics Interest Group RIGNITC Robotics Interest Group Who Are We? The Robotics Interest Group (RIG) was founded out of a passion for robotics, aiming to foster learning and research in areas like Mechatronics, Intelligent Systems, and Automation. We focus on gaining hands-on experience and knowledge to keep pace with evolving technologies, support industry innovation, and contribute to developing practical, commercially viable solutions. Join us to explore the world of robotics, collaborate on exciting projects, and push the boundaries of technology. 0 Technical Workshops 0 Research Publications 0 Industry Grade Projects Know More ↗ RIGNITC B21s B22s @ORIGO23 Featured Projects View All Projects ↗ We Have Alumni in Startups from our Lab Gallery

[https://rignitc.com/about/]
About | Our Story ABOUT US Driven by Innovation, Fueled by Passion. Explore the boundless horizons of robotics. How it all began... RIG Members of the B10 Batch with Prof. Sudheer A.P. The Robotics Interest Group (RIG) is a vibrant community at NIT Calicut where passion for robotics drives innovation and fosters a collaborative spirit. We bring together students from diverse engineering backgrounds, each contributing their unique expertise to the development of cutting-edge robotic solutions. More than just an extracurricular, RIG ignites curious minds through workshops, open labs and hands-on projects. Where it all began In 2011, a group of students became enthused about participating in RoboCon 2012. Despite efforts to construct robots during holidays, they faced funding challenges and were asked to prove credibility. Undeterred, the group broadened their scope and sought guidance, eventually forming a cohesive team of 14 students under the mentorship of Mr. Sudheer A.P. Their first creation, Plotterbot v1.0, helped establish credibility at the institute. They restored lab equipment, secured extended lab access, and continued working through breaks. A pivotal presentation on May 20 led to official recognition of the Robotics Interest Group (RIG) and funding that enabled participation in RoboCon 2013. Way Forward RIG now stands as a community defined by resilience and creativity. We continue to run workshops, mentor newcomers, and pursue projects that push the boundaries of what’s possible. Our focus is to inspire and educate, creating pathways for students to contribute to robotics research and real-world applications. What We Do? UNLEASH INNOVATION — We organise hands-on workshops, open lab sessions, collaborative team projects, and competition prep. Our activities range from introductory electronics and programming sessions to advanced system design and deployment. In the Spotlight A glimpse of our media moments, collaborations, and stories that shaped RIG. Featured in NewsPapers Inker Robotics Tathva Tech Fest Janatics Skill Automation Challenge

In partnership with these companies, Foundry solves complex visualization challenges to turn incredible ideas into reality. Its products are used to create breathtaking visual effects and animation on a wide range of feature films, episodic content, and commercials. Foundry software was integral in the making of every VFX Academy Award-winning film since 2007.
